hook: UK firms say they can't afford to hire under-25s
body: Rising employer costs mean young people are getting passed over. A new report wants to cut those costs for workers aged 21 to 24.
takeaway: Entry-level jobs are getting tougher everywhere. Proof of skill, like a project or an internship, now counts as much as the degree.

hook: Pay off a 7.9% car loan or invest the money?
body: A 24-year-old earning ₹1.27 lakh with a ₹21 lakh portfolio asked the internet. The whole debate comes down to one comparison.
takeaway: Prepaying a loan is a guaranteed 7.9% return. Investing only wins if you can beat that after tax and sit through the bad years.

hook: Nvidia's CEO resigned. Now investors are nervous.
body: Jensen Huang co-founded the AI chip giant. With him gone, the shares are falling right before its earnings report.
takeaway: When one person is the face of a company, their exit can move the stock overnight. That's key-person risk, and why you spread your money out.
